steps: Given: Isotopes of krypton: ⁸⁰Kr (2.0%), ⁸²Kr (12.0%), ⁸³Kr (12.0%), ⁸⁴Kr (57.0%) and ⁸⁵Kr (17.0%).
Required: Relative atomic mass of krypton.
Formula: Relative atomic mass = Σ (isotopic mass × percentage abundance) / 100.
Rounding to one decimal place: Relative atomic mass of krypton = 83.7.
